question: Can the frozen current legacy runtime reconstruct the exact job-293567 K=10000 baseline on all 36 cases, including the model-consumed inputs, physical predictions, and a corrected metric reduction?

stage_a_license.scope: licenses this reconstructed Stage-B replay only

hypothesis.prediction: Two process-isolated BF16 lanes will independently reconstruct the frozen 10,000-cell block for every case, agree as raw bytes for every persisted array, pass all model-consumed input and training-to-physical controls, and reproduce all 72 archived physical prediction fields as raw float32 bytes.
hypothesis.falsifier: Both complete lanes and every deciding input/control artifact are structurally and provenance-valid, all input-parity gates pass, and at least one archived physical prediction field or the frozen historical pressure reduction fails its preregistered exact/tolerance gate.
not_a_falsifier: a missing lane, sidecar, archive payload, manifest, metric log, normalization state, or reducer artifact
a producer, helper, reducer, source, config, checkpoint, manifest, metric, or Stage-A-license hash mismatch
a selected-cell, selected-target, model-consumed-input, archive-normal, truth-chain, or training-to-physical control failure
a malformed, aliased, non-transactional, non-finite, or schema-invalid artifact
